title: Meta ordered to pay $567 million into abatement fund as remedy to child harms case in New Mexico
summary_full: A judge in New Mexico ordered Meta to pay $567 million into an abatement fund after a jury ruled the company violated the state’s unfair practices act.
summary_public: A judge in New Mexico ordered Meta to pay $567 million into an abatement fund after a jury ruled the company violated the state’s unfair practices act.
